title: Stevies (Cobblemon add-on)
description: This datapack adds Steve to fight with you in cobblemon
body:
This datapack adds Steve to the world of Cobblemon! information about the exact stats, evolutions, movesets etc. will be provided lower in the description. Make sure that you have put the pack into both the datapacks and resource packs folders, otherwise it will either not work or show as substitude dolls

Steve:
Typing: ground/normal
Base stats: hp 55, atk 65, def 50, sp.atk 45 sp.def 50 spd 55
Abilities: pickup, moldbreaker, (hidden) technician
Drops: iron pickaxe (3% chance)

Moves:

Level up:\
1: tackle, 1: leer, 5: mud slap, 9: quick attack, 13: bulldoze, 17: rock throw, 21: dig, 25: brick break, 29: rock slide, 33: swords dance, 37: earthquake, 41: double edge, 45: stealth rock, 49: headlong rush

TM:

work up, roar, toxic spikes, hidden power, sunny day, taunt, protect, safeguard, frustration, smack down, earthquake, return, brick break, double team, sandstorm, rock tomb, facade, rest, attract, thief, round, echoed voice, focus blast, fling, brutal swing, swords dance, rock slide, swagger, sleep talk, substitude, nature power, confide, bulldoze, rock smash

Egg:

curse, endure, wide guard, ancient power, stockpile, spitup, swallow

Tutor:

block

Additional useful info:

Egg cycles: 20\
Experience group: slow\
Experience yield: 320\
Catch rate: 80\
Always male\
Base friendship: 35/
EV yield: 1 hp, 1 atk\
Height 1,8 meters (18 decimeters) , weight 80 kg (800 hectagrams)

Dex entries:\
#1: Steve yearned for the mines since they were a child\
#2: When Steve meet other trainers they sometimes share their resources with them!

Known issues:\
-The model and animations may sometimes break

What next?
I'm currently working on it's evolutions: miner steve, hunter steve, fighter steve and armored steve, as well as translations for languages other than english
